sources.observation: A subject-authored WIP PR merges Vapor mode development back into Vue core.
A subject-authored compiler-sfc PR stabilizes reactive props destructure, discusses compile-time errors, TypeScript caveats and compatibility safeguards.
A subject-authored reactivity PR designs toValue/toRef normalization for value/ref/getter sources, explains performance motivation, API compatibility and VueUse/vue-demi adoption concerns.
A subject-authored Vite PR states copyright of the subject's Vite code was assigned to VoidZero while other contributors' copyrights and project governance remain unchanged.
A subject-authored Vite rebrand PR coordinates deployment ordering, branch cherry-pick, live asset URLs and README migration.

scope_boundaries: Direct PR authorship supports the specific design/contribution behavior shown, not sole authorship of Vue or Vite.
Vue API and compiler design evidence should not be broadened into all frontend technologies.
Vite governance/rebrand evidence supports project stewardship but is weaker evidence for current build-system implementation depth.
Vapor mode is WIP in the cited source and should not be treated as completed stable delivery solely from that PR.
